evidence: Labeled 'Consensus' and refactors signature-cache hashing invariants in src/script/sigcache.{h,cpp} used during script validation.
rationale: Clarifying implicit preconditions and asserting input validity in signature-cache hashing retires an ambiguous serialization hazard inspired by an Elements vulnerability.
